name: Deana Carter
notes: Soft-focus, airy 90s country-pop — the entry calls it "the *anti*-arena arrangement in the section," and every number here is that sentence. The catalogue is documented as "unusually slow — ballads 61–77, midtempo 94–105, one uptempo cut at 130," so the band centres at 74 rather than the genre's 100. Drums are "recessed — cross-stick verses, brushes and shaker, the snare entering quietly at the chorus and never dominating; kick on 1 and 3 only. Low velocities throughout; ghost notes on the snare between backbeats" — which is the low velocity tier set, the raised ghost probability and the near-absent hat fill. The low end is quoted too: "very long note values, mixed soft; the low end is deliberately unassertive so the acoustic guitar's body carries the bottom," so the bass register tops out low and anticipation is close to zero. Harmony is "I–IV–V and I–V–vi–IV with suspended voicings (Vsus4, IVadd9) doing most of the colour work," which is a high `susSubstitutionProb` rather than a sus numeral — the parser reads degrees, not qualities. Those are the only two families the entry names, and because `progressionFamilies` replaces rather than appends, no third family is authored here; nor does `relatedGenres` claim a shuffle, since the entry never mentions one and this name is not on the section's own `country-shuffle` flag list. Melody "sits low in the register with a narrow range and a breathy attack; density low, phrases short with long rests," hence the raised `emptyBarBias`. ⚠ Confidence is medium and the research says so outright: tempo and palette are documented, "harmonic detail inferred from the lane [LOW-CONF]." ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are the velocity tiers, `emptyBarBias` and the countermelody ratio. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 955/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.24 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "12-string acoustic and pedal steel are the two lead voices; mandolin/dobro for texture; no distorted electric. Melody sits low in the register with a narrow range and a breathy attack; density low, phrases short with long rests.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
